title: Enterprise Security & Sovereign Edge AI: CISO Whitepaper
subtitle: This technical protocol proves absolute algorithmic containment, zero data egress from the corporate firewall, and strict ISO 19650-5 compliance for outsourced BIM execution.

block1.title: 1. Network Isolation Architecture
block1.diagram_caption: Air-Gapped Execution Topology. Absolute containment of geometry and algorithmic metavariables within the corporate LAN perimeter.

rows.execution: Offline LLM deployment and localized processing exclusively on edge hardware.
C# function execution directly on the local Revit database with zero geometry extraction.
Absolute network severance for processing nodes. Data parsing occurs strictly offline.

rows.requirement: Strict execution data privacy & CDE integrity
rows.execution: All client Revit files and geometry transferred via encrypted CDE. Guaranteed deletion post-execution.

block3.title: 3. Zero-Telemetry & Data Retention
block3.notice_text: "The pyBIM infrastructure contains zero background telemetry daemons. Exactly 0 bytes of algorithmic logic, geometric coordinates, or structural parameters are transmitted to public API endpoints."
block3.purge_text: RAG pipeline tensors and intermediate data vectors are instantaneously destroyed upon script execution. State persists solely in the client's air-gapped Common Data Environment (CDE).

sector1_items.title: Drive Encryption Protocols
sector1_items.text: AES-256-XTS At-Rest Encryption. Secure boot mandates locked firmware states.

sector1_items.title: Secure Networking Tunnels
sector1_items.text: Network Ingress/Egress strictly limited to authenticated WireGuard/Tailscale tunnels. Unauthenticated packets dropped at kernel level.

sector2_items.title: Hardened OS Architecture
sector2_items.text: Kernel-level isolation via hardened Linux OS (AppArmor mandatory enforcement).

sector2_items.title: Hardware Isolation
sector2_items.text: Hardware I/O disabled at BIOS level. Headless operation with physical tamper-evident chassis validation.

sector3_items.title: Strict NDA Enforcement
sector3_items.text: Every outsourced BIM project is bound by enterprise-grade Non-Disclosure Agreements. Zero third-party sharing.

sector3_items.title: ISO 19650-5 File Transfers
sector3_items.text: All Revit models and federated IFCs are transmitted via encrypted CDE environments and purged upon project handover.
